distinctiveFeatures.description: Large ivory, gold, and gray floral embroidery sweeps across the lower front of the black kurta.
Ornate dark embroidery decorates the center front and band collar.

visualDescription: A black, straight-silhouette kurta with full-length sleeves, a band collar, and a short split front opening. Contrasting ivory, gold, and gray floral embroidery decorates the chest and sweeps across the lower front, which has a subtle diamond grid texture. It is shown with matching black trousers.
